```{r setup, include=FALSE}

library(CCMHr)
library(gt)
library(kableExtra)
library(MASS)
library(mgcv)
library(refund)
library(scam)
library(splines)
library(tidyverse)

theme_set(theme_minimal() + theme(legend.position = "bottom"))

#         axis.text.x = element_blank(),
#         axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
#         legend.position = "bottom",

# Define a custom color palette for the methods
my_colors <- c(
  "FTTM" = "#440154",
  # "mgcv LFCM" = "#414487",
  "LFCM" = "#2A788E",
  "loglogistic lfAFT" = "#7AD151",
  "lognormal lfAFT" = "#FDE725"
)

# folder_path <- "/Users/weijia/Research/FDA/Simulations/Output/20250822_fttm"
folder_path <- "/Users/weijia/Research/FDA/Simulations/Output/20251024_fttm"
rda_files <- list.files(path = folder_path, pattern = "\\.RDA$", full.names = TRUE)
all_results <- list()
for (i in 1:length(rda_files)) {
  all_results[[i]] <- loadRDa(rda_files[[i]])
}
```


### Computation Time
```{r}
all_info <- data.frame()
# Loop through all scenarios and iterations to extract 'info'
for (scenario in all_results) {
  for (iteration in scenario) {
    all_info <- rbind(all_info, iteration$info)
  }
}

plot_time <- all_info %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c("time_norm", "time_cox", "time_faft2", "time_fttm"),
               names_to = "type",
               values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(est_model = case_when(
            str_detect(type, "cox") ~ "LFCM",
            str_detect(type, "fttm") ~ "FTTM",
            str_detect(type, "norm") ~ "lognormal lfAFT",
            str_detect(type, "faft2") ~ "loglogistic lfAFT",
            .default = "lognormal lfAFT"),
         est_model = factor(est_model, 
                            levels = c("loglogistic lfAFT", "lognormal lfAFT", "LFCM", "FTTM")))

plot_time %>%
  filter(beta_type == "simple") %>%
  ggplot(aes(est_model, value, fill = est_model)) + 
  geom_bar(stat='summary', fun='mean', position = position_dodge()) +
  facet_grid(~family) +
  labs(y = "Computation Time", fill = "Model"
       ) + 
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_blank(), legend.position = "bottom")

# Calculate the average computation time across iterations
table_time <- all_info %>%
  group_by(beta_type, family, n, nS) %>%
  summarise(
    time_norm = round(mean(time_norm, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    time_cox = round(mean(time_cox, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    time_faft = round(mean(time_faft, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    time_faft2 = round(mean(time_faft2, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    time_fttm = round(mean(time_fttm, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

### Average Out-of-Sample Brier Score Across Iterations
```{r}
# box plot
table_Brier <- all_info %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c("Brier_faft", "Brier_cox", "Brier_faft2", "Brier_fttm"),
               names_to = "type",
               values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(est_model = case_when(
            str_detect(type, "cox") ~ "LFCM",
            str_detect(type, "fttm") ~ "FTTM",
            # str_detect(type, "norm") ~ "lognormal lfAFT",
            str_detect(type, "faft2") ~ "loglogistic lfAFT",
            .default = "lognormal lfAFT"),
         est_model = factor(est_model, 
                            levels = c("lognormal lfAFT", "loglogistic lfAFT", "LFCM", "FTTM")),
         family = recode(family, "cox.ph" = "CoxPH"),
         log_value = log(value))

plot_Brier <- table_Brier %>%
  filter(beta_type == "simple" & n == 100) %>%
  ggplot(aes(factor(nS), log_value, fill = est_model)) + 
  geom_boxplot(outliers = FALSE, fatten = 1.3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = my_colors) +
  facet_grid(~family, labeller = label_value, scales = "free") +
  labs(y = "log Brier score", fill = "Model") +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
        strip.text.x = element_blank(),  
        strip.background.x = element_blank()
        )

```

### MISE for Estimated Coefficient Functions Across Iterations
```{r}
all_coef <- data.frame() 

# Loop through all scenarios and iterations to extract 'coef'
for (scenario in all_results) {
  for (iteration in scenario) {
    
    # Extract data for the current iteration
    tmp_data <- data.frame(scenario = iteration$info$scenario,
                           iter = iteration$info$iter,
                           family = iteration$info$family,
                           n = iteration$info$n,
                           nS = iteration$info$nS,
                           b = iteration$info$b,
                           #time = time,
                           beta_type = iteration$info$beta_type,
                           mise_coef_norm = mean(iteration$coef$se_coef_norm),
                           mise_coef_cox = mean(iteration$coef$se_coef_cox),
                           mise_coef_faft = mean(iteration$coef$se_coef_faft),
                           mise_coef_faft2 = mean(iteration$coef$se_coef_faft2),
                           mise_coef_fttm = mean(iteration$coef$se_coef_fttm),
                           cp_coef_norm = mean(iteration$coef$cover_coef_norm),
                           cp_coef_cox = mean(iteration$coef$cover_coef_cox),
                           cp_coef_faft = mean(iteration$coef$cover_coef_faft),
                           cp_coef_faft2 = mean(iteration$coef$cover_coef_faft2),
                           cp_coef_fttm = mean(iteration$coef$cover_coef_fttm),
                           cp_cma_coef_norm = all(iteration$coef$cover_cma_coef_norm),
                           cp_cma_coef_cox = all(iteration$coef$cover_cma_coef_cox))

    # Append to all_coef
    all_coef <- rbind(all_coef, tmp_data)
  }
}


# boxplot
table_mise_coef <- all_coef %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c("mise_coef_faft", "mise_coef_cox", "mise_coef_faft2", "mise_coef_fttm"),
               names_to = "type",
               values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(est_model = case_when(str_detect(type, "cox") ~ "LFCM",
                               str_detect(type, "fttm") ~ "FTTM",
                               # str_detect(type, "norm") ~ "lognormal lfAFT",
                               str_detect(type, "faft2") ~ "loglogistic lfAFT",
                               .default = "lognormal lfAFT"),
         est_model = factor(est_model, 
                            levels = c("lognormal lfAFT", "loglogistic lfAFT", "LFCM", "FTTM")),
         family = recode(family, "cox.ph" = "CoxPH"),
         log_value = log(value))

plot_mise_coef <- table_mise_coef %>%
  filter(beta_type == "simple" & n == 100) %>%
  ggplot(aes(factor(nS), log_value, fill = est_model)) + 
  geom_boxplot(outliers = FALSE, fatten = 1.3) +
  # geom_bar(stat='summary', fun='mean', position = position_dodge()) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = my_colors) +
  facet_grid(~family, labeller = label_value, scales = "free") +
  labs(y = expression("log MISE of"~beta(s)), fill = "Model") + 
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
        strip.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
        strip.text.y = element_blank(),
        strip.background.y = element_blank())
```

### Plot Estimated Coefficient + CI + True Coefficient
Fitted using the log-normal functional AFT model.

```{r}
sub_coef <- data.frame()

# Loop through all scenarios and iterations to extract 'coef'
for (scenario in all_results) {
  counter <- 0  # Initialize a counter

  for (iteration in scenario) {
    # Break the inner loop if 50 iterations for the current scenario are stored
    if (counter >= 1) {
      break
    }

    # Extract data for the current iteration
    time <- seq(0, 1, length.out = iteration$info$nS)
    tmp_data <- data.frame(scenario = iteration$info$scenario,
                           iter = iteration$info$iter,
                           family = iteration$info$family,
                           beta_type = iteration$info$beta_type,
                           n = iteration$info$n,
                           nS = iteration$info$nS,
                           b = iteration$info$b,
                           time = time,
                           censor_rate = iteration$info$censor_rate,
                           true_coef = iteration$coef$true_coef,
                           est_coef_norm = iteration$coef$est_coef_norm,
                           lb_coef_norm = iteration$coef$lb_coef_norm,
                           ub_coef_norm = iteration$coef$ub_coef_norm,
                           est_coef_faft = iteration$coef$est_coef_faft,
                           lb_coef_faft = iteration$coef$lb_coef_faft,
                           ub_coef_faft = iteration$coef$ub_coef_faft,
                           est_coef_faft2 = iteration$coef$est_coef_faft2,
                           lb_coef_faft2 = iteration$coef$lb_coef_faft2,
                           ub_coef_faft2 = iteration$coef$ub_coef_faft2,
                           est_coef_fttm = iteration$coef$est_coef_fttm,
                           lb_coef_fttm = iteration$coef$lb_coef_fttm,
                           ub_coef_fttm = iteration$coef$ub_coef_fttm,
                           cma_lb_coef_norm = iteration$coef$cma_lb_coef_norm,
                           cma_ub_coef_norm = iteration$coef$cma_ub_coef_norm,
                           est_coef_cox = iteration$coef$est_coef_cox,
                           lb_coef_cox = iteration$coef$lb_coef_cox,
                           ub_coef_cox = iteration$coef$ub_coef_cox,
                           cma_lb_coef_cox = iteration$coef$cma_lb_coef_cox,
                           cma_ub_coef_cox = iteration$coef$cma_ub_coef_cox)

    # Append to all_coef
    sub_coef <- rbind(sub_coef, tmp_data)

    # Increment the counter
    counter <- counter + 1
  }
}

  nS <- scenario$nS

    filter(family == !!family, n == !!n, nS == !!nS, beta_type == !!beta_type, b == !!b)

# Create the plot
p <- ggplot(data = scenario_data, aes(x = time)) +
  #geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lb_coef_faft, ymax = ub_coef_faft, fill = "Pointwise CI"), alpha = 0.5) +
  #geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = cma_lb_coef_norm, ymax = cma_ub_coef_norm, fill = "CMA CI"), alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_line(aes(y = true_coef), color = "red", linetype = "dashed", size = 1) +
  geom_line(aes(y = est_coef_norm, color = "mgcv lfAFT"), size = 0.7) +
  geom_line(aes(y = est_coef_cox, color = "mgcv LFCM"), size = 0.7) +
  geom_line(aes(y = est_coef_faft, color = "lognormal lfAFT"), size = 0.7) +
  geom_line(aes(y = est_coef_faft2, color = "loglogistic lfAFT"), size = 0.7) +
  geom_line(aes(y = est_coef_fttm, color = "FTTM"), size = 0.7) +
  scale_color_manual(values = hue_pal()(6)[-1]) +
  # scale_fill_manual(values = c(
  #   "Pointwise CI" = "lightblue"
  #   #"CMA CI" = "lightgreen"
  # )) +
  labs(
    x = "Time",
    y = "Coefficient",
    title = paste("family =",family, "n =", n, "nS =", nS, "beta_type =", beta_type),
    subtitle = paste("b=", b, "censor rate =", censor_rate),
    color = NULL,
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
print(p)
}
```

### Average Coverage Probability of Pointwise CIs for Coefficient Function
```{r}
# Calculate the average CP of Pointwise CIs for Coefficient Function
table_cp_coef <- all_coef %>%
  group_by(b, beta_type, family, n, nS) %>%
  summarise(
    cp_coef_norm = round(mean(cp_coef_norm, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    cp_coef_cox = round(mean(cp_coef_cox, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    cp_coef_faft = round(mean(cp_coef_faft, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    cp_coef_faft2 = round(mean(cp_coef_faft2, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    cp_coef_fttm = round(mean(cp_coef_fttm, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) 

# plot
plot_cp_coef <- table_cp_coef %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c("cp_coef_norm", "cp_coef_cox", "cp_coef_faft", "cp_coef_faft2", "cp_coef_fttm"),
               names_to = "type",
               values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(est_model = case_when(str_detect(type, "cox") ~ "mgcv LFCM",
                               str_detect(type, "fttm") ~ "FTTM",
                               str_detect(type, "norm") ~ "mgcv lfAFT",
                               str_detect(type, "faft2") ~ "loglogistic lfAFT",
                               .default = "lognormal lfAFT"),
         est_model = factor(est_model, 
                            levels = c("loglogistic lfAFT", "lognormal lfAFT", "mgcv lfAFT", "mgcv LFCM", "FTTM")))

plot_cp_coef %>%
  ggplot(aes(factor(n), value, fill = est_model)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge()) +
  geom_hline(yintercept=0.95, linetype="dashed", color = "red") +
  facet_grid(family~beta_type, labeller = label_both) +
  labs(x = "n", y = "Coverage Probability", title = "Average Pointwise Coverage Probability of Coefficient Function Across 100 Simulations", fill = "Model")
```
